why: Nothing in the tree defined which producer fail-closed tag belongs to which lane family,
so three agents partitioned the SAME corpus three different ways in one day:
Every rank in the roadmap is family-boundary-dependent, so every rank was unfalsifiable.
This file is the boundary, as data. Counts computed against it are comparable across
agents and across artifacts; counts computed against anything else are not.
A boundary decision here is a DECISION, not a fact. The ones that could reasonably go the
other way are named in `boundary_notes` with the head that would move, and the report
prints a per-head breakdown inside every family so any alternative boundary can be
recomputed from the printed table instead of argued.
gate_scope: WHAT `--check` GREEN MEANS, measured 2026-08-29 by mutation. The gate enforces TOTALITY and
HYGIENE, never CORRECTNESS: (1) every tag the scan can reach has SOME family, (2) the named
family exists in `families`, (3) no `head_rules`/`tag_overrides`/`not_a_tag` entry is stale,
(4) UNCLASSIFIED is non-empty, (5) with --artifact, the scan explains every OBSERVED tag.
It CANNOT tell a right family from a wrong one. Measured: with `PendingStatic` filed as CONST
the gate exits 0, and it also exits 0 with it filed as MEMORY, PATTERN, CLOSURE, TY,
PRODUCER-INTERNAL, UNCLASSIFIED or ENUM; it exits 1 only when the head is ABSENT or names a
family that does not exist. That is the design — this file IS the decision and the gate only
proves a decision was made — but it means a green here is exactly as good as the derivation
recorded in `boundary_notes`. Adding a head to silence the lane without deriving the family
passes the gate and files the tag wrong, which is the failure this map exists to prevent.

scan_rules.grammar: ^[A-Z][A-Za-z0-9]*(\(.+\))?$, minus literals containing a format placeholder, plus the two legacy lowercase tags listed in `legacy_tags`
scan_rules.completeness: The scan is a heuristic over source text, so it is checked AGAINST the corpus: every tag observed in a scorecard artifact must also be recovered by the scan. That self-test is what found `crates/trust-mir-extract` as a fourth emission root (2 tags the first three roots could not explain). A new emission mechanism therefore fails the check rather than silently escaping the map.

PATTERN.label: match / pattern lowering
PATTERN.definition: A refusal raised while lowering a pattern-matching construct: `match`, its desugars (`if let`, `let else`, `?`, `for`), and the arm/subpattern classifiers. The blocker is the PATTERN, not the scrutinee's type or storage.

MEMORY.label: memory model — slots, places, borrows, projections
MEMORY.definition: A refusal raised because a value lives in, or is reached through, MEMORY rather than the SSA value environment: borrows and reborrows, deref reads and writes, place assignment, promoted slots, field/index projections, pointer-typed values. This is B4's full stated scope (slot table, address-of over slot|ptr with typed projections, Borrow/BorrowMut over places, operand copy/move, non-scalar slots) — deliberately not a narrower reading, because a narrower one manufactures separately-rankable lanes out of B4's own delta items.

CALL.label: call surface + crate seam
CALL.definition: A refusal at a call: callee resolution/identity, argument admission, ABI, fn-ptr reification, and the crate-seam linking that defers a body until its callees exist.

TY.label: type identity / the format's type vocabulary
TY.definition: A refusal from `map_ty` — the format cannot SPELL this type. Spans three B-items (scalar identity B1, fat pointers B2, generics B8); the split inside this family is by detail string, not by head, so ranking a B-item off the TY family total over-counts it. `Ty` bare is the generics wall.

CLOSURE.label: closures, coroutines, capture environments
CLOSURE.definition: A refusal about a closure value, its capture environment, an upvar read, or a coroutine body/yield.

CONST.label: constants, statics, CTFE, the deferred-const finalizer
CONST.definition: A refusal about constant DATA: named consts, const blocks, const params, literals, statics and thread-locals, and the pending-const/pending-str/pending-static finalizer that patches deferred placeholders.

AGGREGATE.label: aggregate construction — struct / tuple / array / slice / union
AGGREGATE.definition: A refusal while BUILDING an aggregate value (or reading a field OF a literal aggregate through the aggregate lane). Distinct from MEMORY, which is about aggregates that live in a slot and are reached by projection.

ENUM.label: enum construction + discriminants
ENUM.definition: A refusal while constructing an enum value or computing a discriminant. Enum MATCHING is PATTERN — see boundary_notes.

OPERATOR.label: operators, casts, coercions, unsizing
OPERATOR.definition: A refusal in a unary/binary operator, a cast, a pointer coercion, or an unsize coercion.

CONTROL.label: control flow — if / loop / break / continue / short-circuit / return
CONTROL.definition: A refusal in a control-flow construct, including the value-position variants (`If(then no value)`, `LogicalOp(rhs no value)`) where the blocker is that a branch produced no value.

PRODUCER-INTERNAL.label: producer self-checks and table invariants
PRODUCER-INTERNAL.definition: Not a coverage lane at all: these fire when an internal invariant of the producer or assembler is violated (a table desync, a provenance seal failure, an adapter flush desync). A nonzero count here is a BUG to fix, never a lane to rank. Kept as its own family precisely so it cannot inflate one.

UNCLASSIFIED.label: no lane owns this
UNCLASSIFIED.definition: Deliberately non-empty and always printed. These tags are blocked by an expression kind or a language feature that NO family and no B-item currently owns; addressing one is opening a NEW lane, not widening an existing one. `Other` — the anonymous catch-all — lives here by name, because the last time a catch-all went unnamed it hid the corpus's second-largest blocker until it was re-attributed. A map that classifies everything is lying; this bucket is where the lie would otherwise be.

not_in_scope.crates/trust-thir-lower/src/to_mir.rs: The SHIM's `unsup("...")` refusals (Call(ledger identity tripwire), Call(site args arity tripwire), Call(ambiguous callee FuncId: index collision), ...) are the trust-ir->MIR flip channel, not the producer's `unsupported` tags. They never appear in a coverage row's `reasons`, so they are deliberately NOT scan roots. Three of them were mistakenly added as overrides while this map was being written; the stale-entry check caught all three in the first run.
not_in_scope.crates/trust-thir-lower/src/flip_registr: flip eligibility, same channel as to_mir.rs

boundary_notes: FailClosed, Rollback and `Call(argument sealed a stub without a tag)` -> PRODUCER-INTERNAL (added 2026-09-29 for F1, the refusal ledger). None of them is a coverage lane: `Rollback(failed attempt left IR behind)` is recorded when a lowering lane tried to discard a failed attempt's tags although that attempt left IR that means something (a seal, a store, a call) in the function -- the attempt's own tags stay and this names the rollback; `FailClosed(stub seal lost its tag)` / `FailClosed(untagged stub)` and the Call-headed tripwire fire only if a fail-closed Unreachable stub reached finalization, or a sealed call argument, with no refusal on record, which the ledger makes impossible by construction. A nonzero count of any of them is a producer defect, which is exactly this family's definition. The Call-headed one is an override rather than a head rule so the CALL head keeps every coverage tag it owns.

Splice -> CALL (added 2026-09-27). 881a7e964a named every refusal to splice an already-lowered body into the crate module (`splice_refusal` in crate_module.rs, carried on coverage rows as `splice_refusal`), which made `Splice(...)` a new head with 37 tags and left fast.trust-ir-tag-families red on main. CALL's definition owns 'the crate-seam linking that defers a body', and a splice refusal is that seam refusing. A few of the tags are assembler invariants rather than seam capability (`Splice(remap certificate)`, `Splice(def table cycle or dangling reference)`, `Splice(prepared body missing)`); they stay in CALL until the detail channel (see pending_dependencies) can split the head, because moving them by name now would rank PRODUCER-INTERNAL off three unmeasured tags.

EnumMatch -> PATTERN, not ENUM. The tag is emitted by the match-lowering path (`lower_enum_match`), and a slice that moves it is match-lowering work. Reading it as ENUM (B3) instead moves 13 tags; the report's per-head table inside PATTERN prints exactly what that would cost, so the alternative is recomputable rather than arguable. This single call is the largest single source of the 107/164/197 pattern-sole spread.

Field/Index -> MEMORY, not AGGREGATE. B4's delta item (2) is literally 'typed projections [Field(idx), Index(v), Downcast(variant)]', so a projection refusal is inside B4's scope. AGGREGATE keeps only CONSTRUCTION.

StaticRef/ThreadLocalRef -> CONST, not MEMORY. wave-SR2 established that static reads are PLACES, which argues for MEMORY; the tags themselves are about admitting static DATA (initializer not scalar, mutable, interior-mutable, foreign), which is CONST work. Moving them costs the printed StaticRef/ThreadLocalRef rows in CONST.
VarRef -> MEMORY. `VarRef(unbound)` and `VarRef(promoted slot missing)` are both slot-model failures; there is no separate 'variable' lane.
Ty spans B1/B2/B8 and is NOT one rankable lane. Rank a B-item off the detail split, never off the TY family total.

The borrow-pointer-VALUE cluster (Deref(non-borrow ptr), Deref(non-scalar pointee), Assign(*r=...), Reborrow) is INSIDE MEMORY under this map — see lane_probes.L10 and the report's DOUBLE-COUNTING section.

PendingStatic -> CONST, not PRODUCER-INTERNAL and not MEMORY (added 2026-08-29 for wave-SD, 6d4e53fbd6). The head is the deferred-LOCAL-STATIC leg of the SAME finalizer that already owns PendingConst and PendingStr: all three are emitted by `bump_unsupported` inside `resolve_pending_consts` (crate_module.rs:3147-3282), all three are recorded on the SAME `PendingConst` struct (the leg is selected by its `static_global` field, crate_module.rs:3162), and all three are consumed identically — a row on the record's `unsupported` vector, which makes `splice_ok` refuse the body and coverage.json record why. PRODUCER-INTERNAL is the nearest alternative and is rejected for CONSISTENCY, not because the reading is silly: 4 of the 5 details (global not found / shape disagreement / global patch conflict / global not patched) ARE internal-invariant tripwires in the sense PRODUCER-INTERNAL describes, and only `eval failed at finalize` is a coverage decline. But `PendingStr(global patch conflict)`, `PendingStr(global not patched)`, `PendingConst(placeholder not found)` and `PendingConst(sentinel leak)` are the identical shapes and are already CONST, and family assignment is keyed on the HEAD, so splitting PendingStatic by detail would need `tag_overrides` and would leave its two twins unsplit — the map would then partition one finalizer three ways, which is the exact unfalsifiability this file exists to remove. If the finalizer's internal tripwires should be PRODUCER-INTERNAL, move all THREE heads together and say so here. MEMORY is closed by the StaticRef/ThreadLocalRef note above: a static's DATA is CONST work under this map even though a static read is a place. Numeric cost of the choice TODAY: zero — no Pending* tag is live in any corpus artifact (checked sd-static-deferral-0829 and postbuild-v38-simd-2026-08-28, 7256 bodies each, 0 events), so this moves no family total and no rank; it is a forward-looking boundary, not a recount.

PendingPromoted -> CONST (added 2026-09-01 for wave-PC). The head is the deferred PROMOTED-LOCAL-CONST leg of the SAME finalizer that owns PendingConst, PendingStr and PendingStatic — emitted by the same resolve_pending_consts path on the same PendingConst record (leg selected by its promoted_global field), consumed identically as an unsupported row. The PendingStatic note's consistency argument transfers verbatim: family assignment is keyed on the HEAD, its five details (eval failed at finalize / global not found / global not patched / global patch conflict / shape disagreement) are the identical shapes its three twins already carry under CONST, and if the finalizer's internal tripwires should ever move to PRODUCER-INTERNAL, all FOUR heads move together.

Join -> CONTROL, with If/Loop. The tag is emitted by the control-flow JOIN lowering (the merge of if/match arms into a local), so a slice that moves it is join-machinery work; the wave-CS detail (opaque carrier typed sink) describes the VALUE refused at the join, not a different lane. Reading it as PRODUCER-INTERNAL would hide a user-visible refusal class inside plumbing accounting.

CoroutineResume -> CLOSURE, not CALL. The tags are pushed at a CALL-resolution site (the coroutine-resume arm), so CALL is the defensible alternative and the per-head table inside CLOSURE prints what moving them would cost. Filed with CLOSURE because the family exists to group residue by the LANE that would retire it, and every one of these is retired by the B5 coroutine frame-protocol work — the same lane that already owns `Yield`. A resume refusal is coroutine work wearing a call's clothes, not call work.

detail-channel (reason_details / at=).owner: the Rank-2 pending-const lane, as a ride-along on its corpus re-run — NOT implemented here, deliberately, to avoid duplicating it
detail-channel (reason_details / at=).what_it_would_add: Family assignment is keyed on the tag HEAD, and two heads are un-splittable blobs today because the scorecard's per-body `reasons` carry the tag only, never the detail. `Ty` is ONE head with 771 events and 119 sole bodies spanning three B-items (B1 scalar identity, B2 fat pointers, B8 generics); `Call` is ONE head with 2301 events spanning callee resolution, argument admission and ABI. With the detail channel in the body rows, `head_rules` gains a `detail_rules` sibling and TY/CALL split by B-item, which is the difference between 'the TY family is 119 sole' (true but unrankable — see boundary_notes) and a per-B-item rank. Until then, do not rank a B-item off a family total.
detail-channel (reason_details / at=).blocked_on: a corpus re-run; the map and its gate work without it

L10-borrow-pointer-value.claim: The roadmap ranks this as a separable lane. If every one of its tags falls inside a single family, ranking BOTH the probe and that family double-counts the same bodies and one of them must be struck.
